Are you looking for job in logistics field as an order picker? 
As an Order Picker, you will collect customer orders and prepare them for shipment using a trolley. This is a walking order-picking position. Orders are picked using a voice-picking system available in English and Polish. During your first days, you will be supported through a buddy system to help you learn the processes and become familiar with the warehouse. You will work in a cold environment (4-6 degrees). 
The expected picking performance is between 200 and 220 picks per hour. The position operates in two shifts: Sunday evening until Saturday morning (19:00 - 04:00) or Monday till Saturday (05:00 - 16:00) . Depending on the shift schedule, you will work either 5 or 6 days per week. An evening allowance of 130% applies, while work on Sunday evenings is paid at 200%. For safety reasons, wearing certified safety shoes and appropriate work clothing is mandatory at all times.

As a Field Service Panel Builder Technician, you will work on a variety of electrical installations at customer sites throughout the Netherlands. Your responsibilities include assembling, installing, connecting, commissioning and maintaining electrical distribution systems and control panels. You will work both on-site with customers and in the workshop. At customer locations, you ensure that electrical installations are installed safely, correctly and according to specifications. You will also troubleshoot electrical faults, identify the root cause of problems and provide effective solutions to get the customer's installation back up and running as quickly as possible. Your work is both electrical and mechanical, making this a varied and hands-on position. You will build cabinets based on electrical schematics, connect electrical installations and, when required, interconnect panels on-site when they cannot be transported as a single unit. You will also have direct contact with customers and coordinate your activities with them to ensure that installation and service work causes as little disruption to their operations as possible. During periods with less field service work, you will support the workshop team by building electrical panels based on technical drawings and schematics. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A varied technical position combining field service, panel building and electrical installation. Work at different customer locations throughout the Netherlands. A high level of independence and responsibility in your daily work. Opportunities to develop your technical skills through relevant training and education. The opportunity to obtain additional certifications such as VCA and NEN 3140. A combination of workshop-based and customer-facing work. Participation in on-call and breakdown services. 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days Wat levert deze baan jou op? A lot of variety. You will not be doing the same thing every day. You will work at different customer locatio

and deal with different electrical installations and technical challenges. Hands-on technical work. You will work directly with electrical distribution systems, control panels and electrical installations, allowing you to put your practical skills to use every day. Independence and responsibility. The combination of electrical and mechanical work makes this a broad and challenging position where you will continuously encounter different technical situations. Room to develop. You will have the opportunity to follow relevant courses and training and further develop your career within electrical engineering, panel building and service. A solid background in electrical engineering and electrical installations. Experience in panel building is highly preferred. Strong practical and technical skills. Able to analyse technical problems and troubleshoot faults independently. Accurate, safety-conscious and responsible in your work. Grace Church Amsterdam is an English speaking Christian church serving an international community in Amsterdam. We are seeking a full time Lead Pastor and Lead Elder to provide pastoral, theological and organizational leadership to the church.

The Lead Pastor will serve as a Staff Elder and work together with our lay elders. Responsibilities include preaching regularly, overseeing Sunday worship gatherings, leading elder meetings, providing pastoral care, equipping church members for discipleship and evangelism, developing future elders and deacons, supervising staff, and overseeing the day to day operations of the church.

The candidate must be able to affirm the doctrinal statement of Grace Church without reservation. We are seeking a pastor committed to expository preaching, the authority and inerrancy of Scripture, complementarian convictions, and Reformed soteriology.

Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required. The candidate must be able to preach, teach, provide pastoral care, lead meetings, and supervise staff in an English speaking church environment.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter explaining their relevant ministry experience and interest in serving Grace Church Amsterdam.
